query: Please implement a form approval system for managing approval processes and configuring forms. The system should have functionalities for managing approval workflows, configuring forms, customizing configurations, and completing processes. Users should be able to log in, create and manage approval workflows, configure form fields, customize form content, and submit approval requests. The system should also be able to implement complex interactions between fields, automatically updating the values of related fields. Apply snow as the background; style all components with dim gray.
